functional_goal: Complete MTM-reboot's all-Rust operational composition, remaining bounded adapters, public tool backend, operator UI/Quick Tunnel, and installable single-binary distribution without redesigning the already accepted Native, storage, OAuth/MCP, workflow, verifier, or finalizer authorities.

components: validated RuntimeSettings and owner-only secret materialization
RuntimeToolBackend for 24 public tools and 11 hidden aliases
presentation-only OperatorSession and owned Quick Tunnel session
static hash-bound tool catalog and methodology assets
release cargo-install path distribution without Python linkage

authority_boundaries.OAuthPrincipal: private validated state, no production Deserialize/public constructor; conformance fixture is feature-gated off by default
authority_boundaries.OperatorSession: presentation-only event/tunnel sink with no store, capability, vault, or workflow authority
authority_boundaries.runtime: only wide composition crate; leaf crates retain their prior authority restrictions
authority_boundaries.isolation: Rust policy and process ownership continue to actuate the already-validated Bubblewrap OS sandbox

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Post-commit revalidation found the supposedly completed MTM-006 target binary could not pass all-target Clippy because it depended on a dev-only tempfile crate, and its LaTeX fixture/evidence-hash binding were also incomplete.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Paused MTM-007, repaired and recommitted MTM-006 as 3c695ecdbe4351142105148d688c9e07879e6eeb, reran its differential/real target gates, then began MTM-007.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: OAuthPrincipal was a public-field Deserialize DTO, allowing in-process callers to manufacture an authenticated value even though the HTTP path still validated bearer tokens.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Made OAuthPrincipal non-publicly constructible/deserializable and retained only a default-off shadow-fixture constructor so the frozen MTM-005 corpus still matches exactly.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Changing the shadow harness to use full OAuth validation initially changed the frozen event sequence even though Python-Rust differential values still matched.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Kept production principal hardening while using the explicitly feature-gated shadow fixture; the original 44-record golden SHA remained unchanged with zero mismatches.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: A direct hand-copied 50 KiB catalog asset was judged too error-prone for byte fidelity.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Discarded that attempt and mechanically encoded the frozen source catalog as base64 in four verified chunks; all 570 lines and decoded raw SHA-256 were checked exactly before use.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The initial eighteen end-to-end Python-Rust checkpoints reported three mismatches: server_info omitted source fields, disabled Native warning text drifted, and git_blame names/types differed.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Restored source server_info facts, exact warning wording, and blame commit/original_line/line/author/email/time/summary/content structure rather than hiding differences with normalization.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first zero-mismatch full-composition runs still produced different corpus hashes because file modified timestamps changed between fixture runs.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Fixed Git author/committer time and explicitly classified only modified/time/run/capability/trace/path facts as dynamic; two consecutive runs then produced stable SHA-256 6aa4f5699df7099d29c12859788430bd6b1c66a8295828598b6cae62a964d830.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: cargo package first rejected internal path dependencies without version requirements.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added exact =0.1.0-alpha.1 version metadata to all internal path dependencies. A later cargo package correctly stops because private mtm-* crates are not published to crates.io; MTM-007 accepts single-binary cargo-install/path distribution instead of claiming public-crate publication.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Real A4 showed RuntimeLatexGate saw compile_available/attempted but no real exit/stdout/stderr because run_fixed_helper_in_workspace returned only the validated helper attestation object.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added validated_execution_response: it first validates the complete helper attestation, then requires and preserves bounded execution fields. A Rust unit regression verifies exit/output survival.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: After the execution-response fix, latexmk returned real exit code 12 because the target fixture used the theorem environment without an explicit newtheorem declaration.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Confirmed the same failure outside Bubblewrap, fixed only the target document fixture, and reran the complete public-tool workflow to real finalization.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first public metadata fetch occasionally hit TLS EOF immediately after cloudflared announced its random URL.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Kept the exact public metadata requirement but added a bounded 30-second retry window for edge propagation; owned child cleanup remained mandatory.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: MTM-007 source and Cargo.lock changes correctly made every MTM-003/004/005/006 implementation-bound target report stale.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Reran real Native/CAS/QuickTunnel, copied-database/rollback, Firefox OAuth/MCP, and pdflatex workflow target suites and their validators; no report hash was manually edited.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first unified run_checks after adding mtm-runtime failed because a governance test still hard-coded the old seven-member Cargo workspace.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Updated the graph/test facts and strengthened the engineering validator to enforce the unique runtime root, CLI presentation boundary, opaque OAuthPrincipal, presentation-only observer, and embedded asset hashes.
